headline: Heliotrope Real Estate files substantial acquisition disclosure in RattanIndia Power
sum: Heliotrope Real Estate Private Limited has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in RattanIndia Power Limited. The filing marks the public announcement of the transaction under India's takeover code.
detail: Heliotrope Real Estate Private Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer acquires shares or voting rights exceeding 25% of total shareholding or voting rights, or announces an intention to acquire control. The filing initiates the public scrutiny and compliance window under India's takeover code. Specific details of shareholding percentage, consideration and deal structure are contained in the full disclosure document.
